tw-blackburn-gordon-1897.st: 1880 census: merchant, 50, born Pennsylvania, wife Mary. In Feb. 1898 Charles Beauregard was arrested at the Eau Claire lakes and bound over for trial at Superior; on June 15, 1898 the jury acquitted him after five minutes on purely circumstantial evidence. Robbery was the supposed motive, and the murder was never solved. Blackburn was a wealthy trader and had once carried the mail from St. Paul to Superior.
